message.description: One-sentence explanation for people, at most 4096 bytes. It never contains a host path.

stage.description: The `bundle build` stage the finding belongs to. Absent for other commands and for findings outside a stage (argument parsing).

argument.description: The command-line argument the finding is about, when it is about one.

location.description: Where the finding is, when known.

limit.description: The limit that was hit, for `limit-exceeded` and `diagnostics-truncated`.

description:
One stderr line. stderr is JSON Lines: every line is one compact
CliDiagnosticA0 followed by LF, in the order the findings happen. It is a
log for people and the job log; callers never take control decisions from
it, only from the exit code and stdout.
title: prism-kicad diagnostic a0

CliSeverity.description: How serious a stderr diagnostic is.

DiagnosticCode.description:
Stable machine-readable code of a finding, in lowercase kebab-case, for
example `stale-saved-fills` or `net-mismatch`. A code never changes meaning
once published; a new meaning gets a new code.

CliBuildStage.description:
A stage of `bundle build`, in the order the stages run (ADR §4.4). The
same three stages are recorded in the bundle manifest.

CliArgument.description:
A command-line argument a diagnostic or error is about, named as the usage
text names it: an option by its long name without the leading `--`, a
positional argument by its placeholder. Used instead of echoing the
argument's value, which may be a host path.

path.description:
The file, named by the path it has as a bundle member, whether or not a
bundle has been written yet: `sources/<RepoPath>` for a source file,
`refilled/<board file name>` for the `--refilled-board` input (refill mode only),
`viewer/models/components.glb` for the `--models-glb` input,
the member path itself for a member of an existing bundle. Absent when the finding
is about an argument file that is not a member (`--config`) or about no
file at all.

line.description: One-based line of the finding in a text file.

column.description: One-based column, counted in Unicode scalar values, on `line`.

offset.description: Zero-based byte offset of the finding from the start of the file.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the value in a JSON file (a `.kicad_pro`, `--config`, or a JSON member).

uuid.description: UUID of the KiCad object the finding is about, as written in the file.

CliLocation.description:
Where a finding is. Every field is optional; a field is present only when
it is known. The field names are single words so the model can move to
common.tsp unchanged and serve camelCase documents too.

CliLimitHit.description:
The limit a resource-limit or timeout error, or a diagnostic, hit. The
variant follows the limit name's unit suffix.

ArchivePath.description:
Path of a member inside a `.prism` bundle archive: `/`-separated, relative,
no empty, `.` or `..` segment, no leading or trailing `/`, no backslash and
no `:`. The same rule as manifest a1's ArchivePath and prism-bundle's
`check_member_name`, without lookaround.

CliOneBased.description: A one-based line or column number.

ByteCount.description: A size in bytes: a non-negative safe integer.

CliJsonPointer.description:
A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into a JSON file: empty for the whole document,
otherwise `/`-separated reference tokens with `~0` for `~` and `~1` for `/`.

KiCadUuid.description:
KiCad object UUID in the canonical form KiCad writes (`KIID::AsString`):
lowercase hexadecimal, 8-4-4-4-12. Copied from the file, never generated
or re-cased.

kind.description: Variant tag: the limit is a size in bytes.

limit_bytes.description: The limit's value for this invocation, its default or the `--limit` override.

observed_bytes.description: The size that exceeded it, when the input's size was known before reading it (a file or a declared member size). Absent when the work stopped at the limit without knowing the total, and always for `max-memory-bytes`.

CliByteLimitHit.description: A size limit that was hit: a limit whose name ends in `-bytes`.

kind.description: Variant tag: the limit is a duration.

limit_ms.description: The limit's value for this invocation. No elapsed time is reported: documents carry no measured durations.

CliTimeLimitHit.description: A time limit that was hit: `timeout-ms`.

kind.description: Variant tag: the limit is a count.

limit_count.description: The limit's value for this invocation, its default or the `--limit` override.

observed_count.description: The count that exceeded it, when it was known before stopping (for example the number of selected source files). Absent otherwise.

CliCountLimitHit.description: A count limit that was hit: a limit whose name ends neither in `-bytes` nor in `-ms`.

CliLimitName.description:
A resource limit (cli-spec.md §7.2). The suffix gives the unit: `-bytes` is
bytes, `-ms` is milliseconds, anything else is a count. Every limit can be
set with `--limit <name>=<value>`, up to its hard bound. Hitting one is
never recorded in a bundle: limits are configuration, not part of the
bundle key.

CliMilliseconds.description: A duration in integer milliseconds (conventions.md §6, CLI limits).

Count.description: A count of things: a non-negative safe integer.
